items.body_excerpt:
Shot Making vs Shot Selection

🔵 eFG% - Shotmaking - Adjusting for the extra point from threes, what did the team effectively shoot from the field. 

🟠 Location eFG% - Shot Selection - If this team shot league average from each location where they are taking shots, what would their effective FG% be.

images.alt:
Dumbbell chart titled "Shot Making vs. Shot Selection." Each of the 30 NBA teams has a row with two dots. A blue dot shows shot making (eFG%), which is field goal percentage adjusted for threes being worth more than twos. An orange dot shows shot location (Loc eFG%), the eFG% a team would have shooting league average from its shot locations. A bar connects the two dots. Teams are sorted by the difference, eFG% minus Loc eFG%, from best to worst. A dashed purple line marks the league average eFG% of 53.5%. The x-axis runs from 48% to 60%.

Sixteen teams are making more than their shot locations predict, and 14 are making less. The Lakers lead with an eFG% of 59.7% against a Loc eFG% of 54.1%. The Bulls are last, with an eFG% of 49.1% against a Loc eFG% of 55.9%.
